stories.title: No. 2 BYU latest unbeaten to fall as UCF pulls off double-OT upset
stories.summary: After a wild finish in regulation, UCF knocked off No. 2 BYU on Saturday in a 39-31 double-overtime victory for the first top-five win in program history.

stories.title: Cignetti debated benching Hoover as Hoosiers eke out OT win at Michigan
stories.summary: Josh Hoover had a 4-yard TD run in overtime and No. 6 Indiana kept Michigan out of the end zone in a 13-6 win -- the Hoosiers' first at the Big House since 1967.

stories.title: Giannis fouls out vs. undermanned Hornets as Heat tumble to 0-3
stories.summary: The Heat fell to 0-3 after a 115-110 loss to the undermanned Hornets in which Giannis Antetokounmpo scored just 14 points before fouling out.

stories.title: Ravens rule out QB Jackson (ankle) Sunday vs. Bengals; Huntley to start
stories.summary: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled QB Lamar Jackson out of Sundays game vs. the Cincinnati Bengals as he continues to deal with a high ankle sprain. Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will get the start.

stories.title: Valkyries play without regrets, shut down Dream to even Finals
stories.summary: The Valkyries played stellar defense to beat the Dream and even the WNBA Finals at 2-2.
